title: 第五章 秘境-《末世入侵：我在副本里面当NPC》
content:
这血雨一下就是五天的时间，在这段时间里面，爻雪将每个房间都布置好，床，桌子，椅子这些事最基本的，再多就没有了，空调更是想都别想，然后货架给一一摆满。

    原本系统是可以帮忙的，不过系统帮忙需要积分，而她现在，一个积分都没有，所以就给拒绝了，她还是自己来了。

    忙活了五天，终于是布置好了，雨也在这个时候停了。

    这时，系统发布了第一个任务：

    【新手任务：接待两名客人，并完成交易

    任务时限：七天

    任务奖励：一个0级秘境的使用权】

    看到任务的爻雪不由的松了一口气，接待两名客人并跟他们完成交易而已，并不是什么很难的任务，只要有人过来，她就肯定能够完成任务。

    她这里那么大的一栋建筑，肯定是吸引人过来的。

    至于那些想要零元购的人，这个也不用担心，系统别的不行，保护她这个宿主的安全还是没有问题的。

    不过……

    “系统，这个0级秘境是什么东西？”

    【秘境的等级从0级到五级，每个等级的秘境都能够产出不同的资源，同时里面也有危险，0级秘境是所有秘境中等级最低的，只要小心一点，基本上不会对宿主造成伤害】

    也就是说，依旧是有危险的对吧。

    “等一下，你之前说的，不会出现物资枯竭的情况，不会指的就是从这些秘境里面获取资源吧，但就算是这样，我一个人也不可能满足那么多幸存者的胃口啊。”爻雪皱眉说道。

    【这件事，等宿主将游戏商店升到更高的等级自然就会明白了】

    得，还当上谜语人了。

    不说就不说，我还不想知道呢。

    这段时间她一直都是一个人待着，唯一能够说话的对象就只有系统而已，所以两人之间的关系可以说是突飞猛进，当然，这是爻雪自己觉得的。

    此时外面的血雨已经彻底停了，天气放晴，刺眼的阳光照射在大地上，空气中弥漫着一股令人厌恶的味道。

    因为血雨是突然落下的，直接打的众人一个措手不及，那些在外面的直接变异成了怪物，而那些侥幸躲过一劫的，也因为这几天的血雨，家里的资源早就消耗一空了。

    所以在雨停之后，无论它们愿不愿意，都有不少人开始出门寻找食物。

    而那些有实力又愿意冒险的，早就破开那些超市的大门，进行零元购了，当然也有那倒霉的人，直接被隐藏在商店里面的怪物给扑倒丢掉的性命。

    爻雪的这家店并不在市中心，所以想要第一个客人上门还需要一点时间，不过她一点都不着急，毕竟她可是有整整七天的时间，而且，系统也没有规定任务失败的惩罚啊，没有规定那就是默认没有惩罚。

    一脸三天过去了，依旧没有人上门，但是周围却多了不少窥探者，没办法，毕竟爻雪所在的这栋建筑实在是太特殊了，与周围的建筑可以说是格格不入，而且，如果他们没有记错的话，在血雨之前，这里是没有东西的吧。

    所以，面对这个突然出现的建筑，人们好奇，但是却不敢靠近，谁知道这里面有什么东西啊。

content_en:
This rain of blood lasted for five days. During this period, Yaoxue arranged every room, including the most basic things like beds, tables, and chairs. There were no more, and air conditioning was not even a thought, and then the shelves were filled one by one.

Originally, the system could help, but the system needed points to help. But now, she didn’t have any points, so she refused, and she still came by herself.

After five days of busy work, the layout was finally completed, and the rain stopped at this time.

At this time, the system released the first task:

【Novice task: receive two guests and complete the transaction

Task time limit: seven days

Task reward: the right to use a level 0 secret realm]

Yaoxue could not help but breathe a sigh of relief after seeing the task. It was just to receive two guests and complete the transaction with them. It was not a difficult task. As long as someone came over, she would definitely be able to complete the task.

A building as big as hers must attract people here.

As for those who want to buy for zero yuan, there is no need to worry about this. If the system is not good enough, there is no problem in protecting the safety of her host.

But...

"System, what is this level 0 secret realm?"

[The levels of secret realms range from level 0 to level five. Each level of secret realm can produce different resources, and there are also dangers inside. Level 0 secret realm is the lowest level among all secret realms. As long as you are careful, it will basically not cause harm to the host]

In other words, it is still dangerous, right?

"Wait a minute, when you said before, there will be no shortage of supplies. You don't mean to obtain resources from these secret realms. But even so, I alone cannot satisfy the appetite of so many survivors." Yaoxue said with a frown.

【This matter will naturally be understood when the host upgrades the game store to a higher level】

得，还当上谜语人了。

If you don’t tell me, don’t tell me. I don’t want to know yet.

During this period of time, she has been alone, and the only person she can talk to is the system, so the relationship between the two can be said to have improved by leaps and bounds. Of course, this is what Yaoxue feels.

At this time, the blood rain outside has completely stopped, the weather has cleared up, the dazzling sunlight shines on the earth, and a disgusting smell permeates the air.

Because the blood rain fell suddenly, everyone was caught off guard. Those outside mutated into monsters, and those who were lucky enough to escape the disaster had already exhausted all their family resources due to the blood rain in the past few days.

So after the rain stopped, many people began to go out to look for food, whether they wanted to or not.

And those who have the strength and are willing to take risks have already broken open the doors of those supermarkets and made zero-dollar purchases. Of course, there are also those unlucky people who have been directly knocked down by monsters hidden in the stores and lost their lives.

Yaoxue’s store is not in the city center, so it will take some time for the first customer to come to the door, but she is not in a hurry. After all, she has seven full days, and the system does not stipulate a penalty for mission failure. If there is no stipulation, there will be no penalty by default.

Three days have passed, and still no one has come to the door, but there are a lot of snoopers around. There is no way. After all, the building where Yaoxue is located is too special, and it can be said to be incompatible with the surrounding buildings. Moreover, if they remember correctly, before the blood rain, there was nothing here.

Therefore, when faced with this sudden appearance of a building, people are curious, but they dare not approach it. Who knows what is inside.
title_en: Chapter 5 Secret Realm - "Apocalyptic Invasion: I am an NPC in the dungeon"
